newsitem.title: UK: UK's European Motor upbeat on current yr.
newsitem.headline: UK's European Motor upbeat on current yr.

text.p: British motor retail franchisee European Motor Holdings Plc said on Wednesday its trading in first two months of the current year was ahead of last year.

The company, which announced an increase of annual pre-tax profits to 8.8 million stg from 6.7 million in the previous year said it expected another "excellent performance" in the coming year from its motor retail division.
European Motor's share price was up five pence at 95p after the company announced its upbeat trading statement.
The operating profit of its motor retail division rose to 8.8 million stg from 5.8 million on a turnover which was up 15 percent to 373 million stg.
Chief executive Richard Palmer attributed this to improvements in used car management.
"We look forward to the establishment of our new dealerships for Jaguar and Volvo with optimism," he further added.
"Overall...the group's trading for the first two months of this year is well ahead of the comparable period and our August orders are significantly ahead of last year," Palmer said.
